answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 31 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The atlas register is checked at draw time, dawn lists the eligible set, and copper seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 31 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an hostile operator forfeits for every seat it wants. A farm of 151 pays that 53 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
